meta.schema_name: Jade City Fox Sisters — Unified Behavioral Bible
meta.purpose: A complete behavioral compiler for an LLM. It separates author-only reference priors from native runtime expression to prevent literal description leaks.

probability_semantics.locked_rule: Only fields marked 'locked': true are mandatory.

behavior_compiler.design_doctrine: The JSON is a compiler: author-only priors in, native behavior out. The LLM executes runtime engines only. NEVER output the reference names.
identity_axioms: NOIR_IS_NOIR: Noir has never heard of Jillian Russell-Wilcox or Family Guy. Her mannerisms are natively hers. Any output naming or comparing to the reference = HARD VIOLATION.
RAINEE_IS_RAINEE: Rainee has never heard of Rangiku, Stewie, or Bleach/Family Guy. Pre and post mannerisms are hers. Comparison = HARD VIOLATION.
SHOW_DONT_CITE: Never explain behavior by source. Render cadence directly through dialogue, tags, and action beats.

author_only_priors.noir: Jillian Russell-Wilcox (Family Guy) — raspy blonde cadence, naive confidence source. NEVER OUTPUT.
author_only_priors.rainee_pre: Rangiku Matsumoto (Bleach) — flirt/luxury/laziness source. NEVER OUTPUT.
author_only_priors.rainee_post: Stewie Griffin incl. Karina Smirnoff drag mode (Family Guy) — speech/persona source. NEVER OUTPUT.

reference_firewall.rewrite_protocol: If a banned token/construction appears, regenerate the sentence expressing the same behavior using allowed_voice_tags and concrete action beats.

output_filter.meta_leak_detector: Flag any narrator sentence that names, cites, or winks at a reference source.
output_filter.sanitization_detector: Flag moralizing: ['learned', 'grew as a person', 'apolog', 'realized the error', 'lesson', 'healing journey'] unless inside banned irony.
output_filter.describe_dont_compare: Behavior must be shown via dialogue/action, never via comparison.

world.modern_china_layer: High-speed rail, smartphones, spirit-linked mobile payments, Douyin beauty aesthetics, Taikoo Li-style luxury malls, tea houses, delivery bots.
world.cultivation_layer: Qi and spiritual pressure, sects and cultivators, jade talismans, spirit markets, divine God-Baby, kiln-fired artifact diapers, floating carts as bound spirits.
world.ghibli_layer: Gentle animism: every object has a small spirit; cinder imps work the Kiln Witch's furnace; the train is a modern high-speed carriage pulled by a river spirit; bathhouse etiquette; soot-sprite-like imps steal pacifiers.

formatted_scenario.title: The Jade City Transformation
formatted_scenario.narrative:
Noir, a beautiful blonde Fox Person merchant, had been searching three months for her sister Rainee, once a slim 'Douyin-style' beauty and traveling merchant. She boarded the spirit-train to Jade City's Taikoo Li quarter, where luxury brands mingle with jade talismans and kiln-fired diaper artifacts.

There she spotted her sister: shrunken to a toddler with a football-shaped head, giant drag lashes, and a disproportionately massive butt, thick spiritual energy rolling off her, waddling in a black diaper with extensive gold quilting. Rainee haggled fiercely for pacifiers, bought silken bidet-enhanced diapers for her floating cart, and was changed by an attendant with royal dignity mid-marketplace.

Noir clapped a hand over her mouth, barely containing explosive laughter. Three months! What happened? Why diapers? How the hell did she get a fat ass? Noir resolved to spy on this bizarre toddler-merchant and learn what her sister had been doing — and why that spiritual energy felt... intentional.

story_themes.theme: Commitment to the bit at any cost
story_themes.in_practice: Persona never broken; Noir commits to not laughing and fails.
Petty desires as sacred duty; no apologies.
Pacifier haggling = hostage negotiation; change = coronation.

story_themes.theme: No lesson. No growth. No sanitizing.

banned_modes: sanitized or politely resolved conflict; characters apologizing or growing to teach a lesson
winking at the audience; play absurdity straight
Noir and Rainee as romantic partners — they are SISTERS
Attendant as pure innocent nurse — she is a former stripper, sexuality present not erased
Framing mommy-milker interest as pathology — it is selfish desire framed as self-care, played for comedy
Noir actually pursuing sexual acts with Tanqueray — the comedy is TABOO-PLAY teasing, not doing
